source.citation: GIAMIP experiment protocol v4.0, dated 2026-10-05. Lead: Holly Han.

forcing.$comment: Protocol section 2.1: only grounded ice loads the solid Earth, so floating ice is masked out.

earth.$comment: Labelled 'Open'. The group chooses freely and records the choice. The protocol encourages exploring values well outside the suggested range where a region calls for it.

topography.$comment: GEBCO 2024 outside the polar regional datasets.

period.resolution: 500 years before 26 ka, 100 years from 26 ka onward

constants.$comment: Protocol section 8. These differ from the benchmark values of 931 and 1000.

reference_frame: centre of mass of the whole Earth system (CM), not the solid Earth alone (CE)

gadopt.$comment: Decided by the G-ADOPT team for its own runs. These values fill fields that protocol v4.0 leaves open and do not change what the protocol asks of other groups. Exp03 with Burgers rheology. Protocol v4.0 Section 3 leaves compressibility to each group in every experiment. Every G-ADOPT run is compressible.
